newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Mercator 1996 net profit jumps 43 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mercator 1996 net profit jumps 43 pct.

text.p: Slovenian trading company Mercator said on Friday 1996 group unrevised net profit rose to 593.5 million tolars ($3.9 million) from 415.7 million tolars in 1995.
The company said restructuring efforts, including a 9.4 percent reduction in the workforce to 9,042, helped raise productivity and profits.
Sales climbed 12 percent to 66.3 billion tolars.
Mercator also confirmed its earlier plan whereby there would be no dividend as profits would be put into reserves.
Mercator, which was listed on the over-the-counter (OTC) market of the Ljubljana bourse in April 1996, has yet to pay a dividend.
Mercator manages 705 stores around Slovenia and a number of food processing companies.
In late trade on Friday, Mercator shares were trading 44 tolars higher at 4,451.
